name: comp-322
title: Feedback Dialog
blurb: Modal for collecting user feedback with helpful resource links.
description: A shadcn Dialog with a textarea for feedback, links to tutorials and documentation, and a send button.
use_when: Enabling users to submit feature requests, bug reports, or general feedback without leaving the current page.
avoid_when: When feedback is better handled through dedicated support channels — a modal interrupts the user's workflow.
a11y: Textarea has aria-label; links are properly styled and keyboard-navigable; inherits focus management from shadcn Dialog.
